description: Edit the caller's own previously-sent message in place (same rkey, new text). For e2ee conversations the caller re-encrypts client-side first and passes the new ciphertext envelope as text, exactly like send — the PDS never sees plaintext either way. Only text/facets/editedAt change; senderDid/createdAt/kind/contentType/replyTo/encryption are preserved from the original record. Structurally self-sovereign: a message can only ever be edited under the sender's own repo, so this can never touch someone else's message.
